title: Completed scalar associator agrees with exact localization
statement: For finite l-adic coefficient extensions E to F to L, every scheme W and every unbounded derived completed integral E-module K, the completed derived tensorComposition followed by completedTensorModel for the composite equals the successive exact-model comparisons followed by the localized ordinary scalar associator. This compares associators only, without any constant-restriction balancing square.

source.place: Tag 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), Tag 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change); ordinary tensor associativity: sites-modules.tex, Tag 03EK.

proof.text: Localize each ordinary scalar adjunction and transport its left functor by completedTensorModel. On every K-flat complex the resulting unit satisfies the defining pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction_exists equation, by completedTensorModel_counit and the ordinary unit formula. Uniqueness identifies this adjunction with the specified derived adjunction. The identity-on-sections restriction compositor localizes to pbcDerivedRestrictComp by definition. Localization preserves composite adjunction units and their transport by that compositor. Finally leftAdjointUniq preserves the unit and is determined by that condition, so the completed derived associator is the localized ordinary associator conjugated by the three exact models. This gives the displayed equation. Exactness makes all computation comparisons invertible and removes boundedness assumptions.

theorem completedTensorModel_composition
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra ℚ_[l] F] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
    (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (j : F →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W)) :
    (haveI := (completedTensor_exact l E F i W).1
     haveI := (completedTensor_exact l E F i W).2
     haveI := (completedTensor_exact l F L j W).1
     haveI := (completedTensor_exact l F L j W).2
     haveI := (completedTensor_exact l E L (j.comp i) W).1
     haveI := (completedTensor_exact l E L (j.comp i) W).2
     haveI := pbcExtend_additive (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)
     haveI := pbcExtend_additive (completedCoefficientMap l F L j W)
     haveI := pbcExtend_additive (completedCoefficientMap l E L (j.comp i) W)
     (PurCompactSupport.tensorComposition _ _ _
       (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E F i L j W)).hom.app K ≫
       (completedTensorModel l E L (j.comp i) W).hom.app K =
     (pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l F L j W)).map
       ((completedTensorModel l E F i W).hom.app K) ≫
       (completedTensorModel l F L j W).hom.app
         ((pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
       ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
         Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
           (ordinaryScalarAssociator _ _ _
             (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E F i L j W))).hom.app K)
